summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a match where they created plenty of chances but were undone by defensive lapses and missed opportunities in front of goal. Saul Shotton pulled one back with a fine far post volley late on, but it wasn't enough to salvage a result that the players will be keen to put behind them. The Bach turn their attention to Saturday's fixture against Stafford Town as they look to bounce back from the disappointment.
